mapper.select: SELECT * FROM admin_legacy_mail_rule WHERE research_no = #{researchNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM admin_legacy_mail_rule WHERE enabled_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY research_no DESC
SELECT * FROM admin_legacy_mail_rule_item WHERE enabled_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY research_no DESC, threshold_count ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM admin_legacy_mail_rule_item WHERE research_no = #{researchNo} AND enabled_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY threshold_count ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_legacy_mail_rule ( research_no, threshold_count, template_id, direct_mail_subject, direct_mail_body, attachment_type, enabled_yn, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{researchNo}, #{thresholdCount}, #{templateId}, #{directMailSubject}, #{directMailBody}, #{attachmentType}, #{enabledYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE threshold_count = VALUES(threshold_count), template_id = VALUES(template_id), direct_mail_subject = VALUES(direct_mail_subject), direct_mail_body = VALUES(direct_mail_body), attachment_type = VALUES(attachment_type), enabled_yn = VALUES(enabled_yn), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO admin_legacy_mail_rule_item ( research_no, threshold_count, template_id, direct_mail_subject, direct_mail_body, attachment_type, enabled_yn, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{researchNo}, #{thresholdCount}, #{templateId}, #{directMailSubject}, #{directMailBody}, #{attachmentType}, #{enabledYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_legacy_mail_rule SET threshold_count = NULL, enabled_yn = 'N', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE research_no = #{researchNo}
UPDATE admin_legacy_mail_rule SET threshold_count = NULL, enabled_yn = 'N', last_triggered_at = #{lastTriggeredAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE research_no = #{researchNo}
UPDATE admin_legacy_mail_rule_item SET enabled_yn = 'N', last_triggered_at = #{lastTriggeredAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_legacy_mail_rule SET last_triggered_at = #{lastTriggeredAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE research_no = #{researchNo}
UPDATE admin_legacy_mail_rule_item SET last_triggered_at = #{lastTriggeredAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
